name: outage-driven seat failover consults the Model Steward for certified substitutes

scenarios.name: a sustained outage record triggers steward consultation for the affected seat

steps.text: an outage record for provider "anthropic" model "claude-opus-5" has exceeded the duration threshold
the outage names seat "architect" as affected
the coordinator evaluates outage-driven failover
it consults the steward for an assignment-eligible substitute for seat "architect"
it does not consult before the duration threshold is met

scenarios.name: a substitute is applied only at an idle or turn boundary

steps.text: a certified substitute is available for the affected seat
the seat is mid-turn with live work in progress
failover would apply the substitute
the swap is deferred until the next idle boundary
no respawn into a live turn is performed

scenarios.name: the seat reverts to the pack canonical model when the outage record closes

steps.text: a failover swap is active for seat "architect"
the outage record sets endedAtUtc
the coordinator evaluates reversion at the next idle boundary
the seat reverts to the pack's canonical model for that seat
the revert is automatic without a separate human ask

scenarios.name: uncertified models are never applied on the outage failover path

steps.text: the only available substitute for the seat is uncertified
the coordinator evaluates outage-driven failover
no substitute is applied
--override-uncertified is not used on this path

scenarios.name: every swap and revert is announced and logged as a COST experiment annotation

steps.text: a failover swap or revert is applied
an Operator-topic announcement names seat from-model to-model incident and revert condition
a COST-root experiment-log annotation records the seat change

scenarios.name: anthropic claude-opus-4-8 is registered and certified as same-provider fallback

steps.text: anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 is not yet in the steward registry
the designated fallback registration runs
anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 is present in the registry
it is assignment-eligible as the same-provider fallback for opus-class outages

background.text: the Model Steward registry includes certified substitutes
provider-outage records name affected seats with duration and endedAtUtc
